note: min_passed is a floor, not a target: raise it when tests are added; lowering it needs a reviewed reason. Allowed skips are hardware/platform/pinned-optional-dependency only; OpenCL tests execute in the opencl-reference job. platform_skip_reasons are allowed only on the named os.name (e.g. POSIX-only tests may skip on a Windows runner, never on Linux) and do not count toward max_skipped.
